model: Visit badges, review bubbles, and hovered cluster circles painted blurred shadows on the map. The shadows are gone. The badge, bubble, and circle stay.

noise.rule: A visit badge exists only when the visit count is at least 2. Review bubbles are capped at 5 desktop and 3 mobile. The cluster shadow ran only while the pointer was over a cluster, and that hover scale is gone too. Not a sampled paint trace.
